what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Ethiopia in Somalia: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 24952 Ethiopian asylum seekers in Somalia, 16.8% of all asylum seekers from Ethiopia.
Refugees from Ethiopia, a separate group, live mostly in Sudan, Kenya, Uganda and South Africa.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over Ogaden territory in Ethiopia from 1998 to 2016, with the ONLF and AIAI, and over Oromiya territory in many years, most recently with the OLA from 2019 to 2025.
It also records armed conflict over the government of Ethiopia with the TPLF and GLF from 2020 to 2022, at war level.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2001 at 60 asylum seekers.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2009 to 2010 and 2017 to 2025, and the figure is at its highest at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Somalia.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Somalia only.
